verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses any policy, setting, or contractual commitment about AI training data usage; Hoppscotch's AI features and self-hosting are mentioned but nothing states that user data (self-hosted or cloud) is excluded from AI model training. missing for 10: explicit data-usage/training opt-out policy, terms-of-service language on AI training, any documented control to prevent data being used for model training.
